Class CreateInitialSolutionsBinaryParameter

java.lang.Object
org.uma.evolver.parameter.Parameter<String>
org.uma.evolver.parameter.type.CategoricalParameter
org.uma.evolver.parameter.catalogue.createinitialsolutionsparameter.CreateInitialSolutionsParameter<org.uma.jmetal.solution.binarysolution.BinarySolution>
org.uma.evolver.parameter.catalogue.createinitialsolutionsparameter.CreateInitialSolutionsBinaryParameter
public class CreateInitialSolutionsBinaryParameter extends CreateInitialSolutionsParameter<org.uma.jmetal.solution.binarysolution.BinarySolution>
A parameter for creating initial binary solutions in evolutionary algorithms. This parameter defines the strategy used to generate the initial population of binary solutions.

Currently supports the following strategies:

  • DEFAULT_STRATEGY: Creates random binary solutions using RandomSolutionsCreation

Example usage: 


CreateInitialSolutionsBinaryParameter param = new CreateInitialSolutionsBinaryParameter(
    List.of("DEFAULT_STRATEGY"));
param.setValue("DEFAULT_STRATEGY");
SolutionsCreation<BinarySolution> strategy = param.getCreateInitialSolutionsStrategy(problem, 100);
List<BinarySolution> initialPopulation = strategy.create();
